rv.q: What could have been a disastrous vanity project is a startling piece of theatre, arresting and emotional, up there with the best of the modern day Krapps.
Oldman’s performance of Krapp is a wonder to see from start to finish.
As a performer, Oldman is utterly captivating.

cn.t: Gary Oldman delivers an arresting, emotionally powerful performance in Beckett's existential monologue, marking a sentimental return to the stage where he debuted in a startling one-man show.
